R0255.title: Batch After-Sales Compensation Fraud
R0255.definition: Organized groups exploit after-sales and dispute channels to file batch refunds and compensation, fraudulently obtaining payments and goods.
R0255.description:
Batch after-sales compensation fraud uses platform after-sales, return, and dispute channels combined with scripted bulk ordering, fabricated evidence, and concentrated complaints to obtain refunds, compensation, and goods at scale.

The risk causes direct merchandise, payment, and subsidy losses for platforms and merchants while undermining fair after-sales rules. Detection must combine after-sales behavior models, complaint history linkage, and device/address clustering for evidence-chain review.
R0255.influence: Batch after-sales fraud causes direct merchandise, payment, and subsidy losses, raises merchant disputes and support costs, and degrades after-sales experience for genuine users.

references.title: Forged Food Poisoning Extortion of E-commerce Compensation (Sina News, Mass After-Sale Fraud)

observables: Rings use after-sales channels to bulk-initiate refund or compensation appeals
The same device or delivery address is tied to numerous after-sales disputes
Fake after-sales evidence and concentrated appeal patterns are triggered in bulk
After-sales disputes show an abnormally high share of users with historical anomalous appeals
Refund-farm signatures such as empty packages or swaps reappear across related accounts
